what: Plane hit by firework while landing in Chicago

clean_source_blocks.text: The incident happened while the plane was preparing to land in Chicago (file image) A Delta Air Lines plane carrying 52 passengers and six crew members was hit by fireworks as it prepared to land at a Chicago airport on Saturday night. The flight from Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson Airport to Midway International Airport "reportedly made contact with a firework while on descent," a spokesperson for the airline told the BBC. "The flight safely landed and taxied to the gate," they added. There were no injuries and the incident was reported to aviation authorities. The aircraft was struck as millions across the United States celebrated the nation's 250th anniversary with fireworks - part of the annual tradition to commemorate independence. Delta flight 1076 took off from Atlanta at 19:51 EDT (00:51 BST) and landed in Chicago at 20:33 CDT (02:33 BST).
The plane had 52 passengers and six crew onboard. No injuries were reported.

A Delta Air Lines plane was hit by a firework as it was landing at Chicago's Midway Airport on Saturday. The plane landed safely, an airline spokesperson said. It was unclear where the firework came from. CHICAGO - A plane was hit by a firework as it was landing at Chicago’s Midway International Airport on Saturday night. The Delta plane was traveling from Atlanta and landing in Chicago around 8:38 p.m. when it "made contact" with a firework, according to a Delta spokesperson. "The flight safely landed and taxied to the gate," the spokesperson said. The crew reported that the firework had hit the plane. The incident is under evaluation, Delta said. It was unclear where the firework came from or if any damage was sustained.

Delta said the Airbus A319 departed Atlanta at 19:51 Eastern Time and landed safely in Chicago shortly after 20:30 Central Time. The airline said the flight did not declare an emergency. There were 52 passengers and six crew members on board, according to Delta. "Delta flight 1076 from Atlanta (ATL) to Chicago (MDW) reportedly made contact with a firework while on descent. The flight safely landed and taxied to the gate," a Delta spokesperson said. The airline said no-one was injured. The aircraft was withdrawn from service for inspection, but mechanics found no damage. The FAA said it is investigating the incident. original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
The incident happened while the plane was preparing to land in Chicago (file image)

A Delta Air Lines plane carrying 52 passengers and six crew members was hit by fireworks as it prepared to land at a Chicago airport on Saturday night.

The flight from Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson Airport to Midway International Airport "reportedly made contact with a firework while on descent," a spokesperson for the airline told the BBC.

"The flight safely landed and taxied to the gate," they added. There were no injuries and the incident was reported to aviation authorities.

The aircraft was struck as millions across the United States celebrated the nation's 250th anniversary with fireworks - part of the annual tradition to commemorate independence.

Delta flight 1076 took off from Atlanta at 19:51 EDT (00:51 BST) and landed in Chicago at 20:33 CDT (02:33 BST).

"We just had a firework hit our plane," a pilot told air traffic control, a recording of the incident shows. The pilot said it had occurred at about 200ft (61m).

"We're just hoping it was just a mortar that went off underneath but definitely felt a big bang."

Before the incident, controllers can be heard warning of the presence of fireworks.

"Delta 1076... use caution, there are multiple homes near the approach end shooting off fireworks," an air traffic control officer said.

"There have been multiple reports as you can imagine," the controller adds on the radio. "The city is aware. They said they would notify the Chicago police, but you know, I don't know what they will do."

The Federal Aviation Administration said the incident happened around 20:30 CDT, according to CBS News, the BBC's US partner.

The Airbus A319 was inspected after landing with no damage found, according to the airline.

The largest displays of fireworks are often organised by state and local governments, but private and often unsupervised fireworks also are commonplace.

In Washington DC, the milestone anniversary was marked by a mammoth 40-minute fireworks display by the National Park Service at the Washington National Mall.

Flights were suspended at nearby Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport from noon on Saturday to make way for military flyovers and the pyrotechnic show which began at midnight local time.

---

A Delta Air Lines flight was struck by a firework while descending to land at Chicago Midway International Airport during Independence Day celebrations, US aviation authorities have said. The incident involved Delta Flight 1076, which was arriving from Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport at about 20:30 local time on Saturday, according to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

Air traffic control audio captured the flight crew reporting that the aircraft had been hit. "Tower, we just had a firework hit our plane, Delta 1076, we're continuing," the crew told controllers. "We just heard a bang on the plane, so we'll have to look at it when we get to the gate. We're just hoping it was just a mortar that went off underneath, but definitely felt a big bang."

Delta said the Airbus A319 departed Atlanta at 19:51 Eastern Time and landed safely in Chicago shortly after 20:30 Central Time. The airline said the flight did not declare an emergency.

There were 52 passengers and six crew members on board, according to Delta. "Delta flight 1076 from Atlanta (ATL) to Chicago (MDW) reportedly made contact with a firework while on descent. The flight safely landed and taxied to the gate," a Delta spokesperson said.

The airline said no-one was injured. The aircraft was withdrawn from service for inspection, but mechanics found no damage.

The FAA said it is investigating the incident.

payload.title: Ilotulite osui matkustajakoneeseen laskeutumisen aikana Chicagossa
payload.summary: Delta Air Linesin koneeseen osui ilotulite sen lähestyessä Chicagon Midwayn lentoasemaa. Koneessa oli 52 matkustajaa ja kuusi miehistön jäsentä, eikä loukkaantumisista ilmoitettu.
payload.content:
Delta Air Linesin matkustajakoneeseen osui ilotulite lauantai-iltana, kun lento oli laskeutumassa Chicagon Midwayn kansainväliselle lentoasemalle. Atlantasta lähteneessä koneessa oli 52 matkustajaa ja kuusi miehistön jäsentä, ja lentoyhtiön mukaan kone laskeutui turvallisesti, rullasi portille eikä kukaan loukkaantunut.

## Kone pääsi portille omin voimin

Kyse oli Delta Air Linesin lennosta 1076, joka lensi Atlantan Hartsfield-Jacksonin lentoasemalta Chicagoon. Lentoyhtiön edustajan mukaan lento oli laskeutumassa, kun se tietojen mukaan osui ilotulitteeseen. Miehistö ilmoitti osumasta, ja tapaus vietiin ilmailuviranomaisten tietoon.

Delta ilmoitti, ettei lennolla julistettu hätätilannetta. Lentoyhtiön mukaan Airbus A319 lähti Atlantasta kello 19.51 Yhdysvaltain itäistä aikaa ja laskeutui Chicagoon hieman kello 20.30 jälkeen paikallista keskistä aikaa. BBC:n mukaan laskeutumisaika oli kello 20.33 keskistä aikaa.

Laskeutumisen jälkeen kone poistettiin liikenteestä tarkastusta varten. Times Now'n mukaan mekaanikot eivät löytäneet koneesta vaurioita. Aiemmin oli epäselvää, oliko osuma aiheuttanut vahinkoa.

## Ilotulituksen alkuperä jäi epäselväksi

Tapaus sattui viikonloppuna, jolloin Yhdysvalloissa järjestettiin laajoja ilotulituksia maan itsenäisyyden juhlintaan liittyen. BBC:n mukaan ilotulitukset olivat osa vuosittaista perinnettä, jolla juhlistettiin maan itsenäisyyttä, ja tänä vuonna taustalla oli myös Yhdysvaltojen 250-vuotisjuhla.

AOL:n mukaan ei ollut selvää, mistä ilotulite oli peräisin. Lähteiden mukaan kone oli jo laskeutumassa Midwayn lentoasemalle, kun se osui ilotulitteeseen tai teki siihen kontaktin. Lentoyhtiö kuvasi tilanteen päättyneen turvalliseen laskeutumiseen ja portille rullaamiseen.

## Viranomaiset selvittävät tapausta

Yhdysvaltain ilmailuviranomainen FAA tutkii tapausta. Delta on kertonut asian olevan arvioitavana. Lähteiden mukaan keskeiset tiedot ovat yhteneviä: lento oli matkalla Atlantasta Chicagoon, ilotulite osui koneeseen laskeutumisen aikana, kone jatkoi portille ja henkilövahingoilta vältyttiin.
summary_bullets: Delta Air Linesin koneeseen osui ilotulite laskeutumisen aikana Chicagossa.
Koneessa oli 52 matkustajaa ja kuusi miehistön jäsentä, eikä loukkaantumisia raportoitu.
Kone tarkastettiin laskeutumisen jälkeen, eikä mekaanikkojen kerrottu löytäneen vaurioita.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu yhteneviin tietoihin lennosta, matkustajamäärästä, turvallisesta laskeutumisesta, henkilövahinkojen puuttumisesta ja FAA:n tutkinnasta. Ilotulitteen alkuperästä ei ollut vahvistettua tietoa.
